steps.prompt: Produce market research for the supplied idea. Include target users, pain points, current alternatives, positioning, and open questions. Cite workspace filenames for claims.
Turn the market research and initial input into an ordered implementation plan. Include concrete steps, acceptance criteria, dependencies, and risks. Cite workspace filenames and previous artifacts.

Convert the plan into worker-ready implementation instructions. Include file-level targets, exact behavior changes, verification steps, and handoff notes. Cite workspace filenames and previous artifacts.
